not_found: Royal Pharmaceutical Society pages on rpharms.com now redirect to the Royal College of Pharmacy (rcpharm.org); the Royal College pages were read instead.
Board of Trustees page lists the Vice Chair as to be confirmed, and the Senate early careers seat as to be confirmed; neither recorded.
Paid staff (Interim CEO, Chief Scientist, Director of Pharmacy, executive team, UKCPA chief executive and operations staff) deliberately not recorded.

Conference speakers page (rcpharm.org/events/rcpharm-annual-conference-2026/speakers/) names speakers only in images; the programme PDF was used instead. Not every session speaker is recorded (about 22 of the more senior ones are).
The web search allowance ran out before LinkedIn checks, so no LinkedIn profile is recorded for anyone; all linkedin_url values are null.
British Pharmacological Society and other pharmacy bodies were not checked.
